# SiteScout by The Wild Tradesman

> SiteScout is a one-time mineral prospecting report for gold metal detecting. Drop GPS coordinates, get a PDF report with ranked gold targets to hunt with a metal detector — bearing, distance, lat/long, depth in feet, what to do at each target, and detector guidance.

## What it is

- A live, dual-pass scan of public data for any GPS coordinates in the US and Canada. Country-aware: a US scan reads US gold records, a Canadian scan reads Canadian records.
- Data sources: USGS MRDS gold occurrences and mining history, Macrostrat geology, BLM active mining claims, USGS 3DEP elevation (LiDAR terrain), USGS earthquakes, USGS NHD waterways, FEMA flood zones, and Xweather lightning (experimental).
- Each report ranks real terrain targets first (deposition zones, scour zones, paleo-channel terraces), then past-producer mines at their raw scores. Active mining claims are marked on the map, unscored, with their lat/long.
- Reports are informational only — not a mineral-resource estimate, not a land-status determination, and not a guarantee of gold.

## Pricing (one-time, no subscription)

- 1-mile radius scan: $19
- 3-mile radius scan: $39
- 5-mile radius scan: $59
- PDF report delivered by email.
